correctness.rationale: The explicit phi(t)=e^-t(1+13t/20+t²/6) is continuous/integrable under both norms. Independently symbolically differentiated six-cone hexagonal Fourier F_z=2z²(Q+3z²)/(z²(z²+Q)²+p), Q=xi²-xi*eta+eta², p=xi²eta²(xi-eta)², and reproduced the exact polynomial P(Q,p) over ((1+Q)²+p)^3. The algebraic invariant 4Q³-27p=(xi+eta)²(2xi-eta)²(xi-2eta)² yields 0<=p<=4Q³/27. For Q<=21, P decreases in p over the allowed interval and endpoint factorization is positive; for Q>=21, discriminant is negative and p² leading coefficient positive. This is an all-frequency analytic proof of strictly positive density and hence strict Bochner PD. Independently obtained Fourier square section G_square(0,sqrt T)=4(T-9)(T-11)/(15(T+1)^4), negative exactly -4/219615 at T=10. Thus not square PD and not a square-positive-preserving m2 mixture. No finite-frequency scan is claimed as a proof.
